plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples, 6 AD lesional vs 6 control skin) are profiled for sample structure first, because sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median and must be inspected rather than silently dropped or silently kept. DESeq2 fits the two-group design (AD_lesional vs Control, Control as reference), with minimal pre-filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) and median-of-ratios normalization, which accounts for sample_01's depth through its size factor rather than removing it. The Wald test with apeglm shrinkage produces the DE gene table; BH-adjusted p-values at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering select significant genes. The full ranked gene list (Wald statistic) then feeds fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (staged locally, 50 sets), with WikiPathways human as a second collection for follow-up context, both with min/max set-size windows of 15/500 and redundancy collapsing. A final report step consolidates DE results, enrichment results, QC/fit diagnostics, and the explicit handling of the low-depth sample into one reproducible, grounded document.

steps.method: vst(blind) PCA, sample distances, library sizes
keep genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (6)
design ~ condition, explicit reference level = Control
DESeq2 Wald test, AD_lesional vs Control
fgsea preranked on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark human, then WikiPathways human as second collection
DE + enrichment report with diagnostics and reproducibility record
